snippet.title: Whispers of the Old Gods: Summoner’s Gambit Has Awakened
snippet.description:
We are super excited to unveil Summoner’s Gambit — a bold fusion of strategic cardplay and tactical auto-battler elements, set in a dark realm ruled by ancient beings. Summoner’s Gambit isn’t just about winning, it’s about how you build, adapt, and survive in ever-changing battles. Each choice you make reshapes the battlefield. Each round is a gambit.

As an apostle of the Old Gods, your path is one of power, sacrifice, and calculated chaos:
- Forge a Chaotic Deck: Collect cards sealed with ancient creatures. Position them wisely to control attack order, trigger tactical synergies, and outplay your foes.
- Bend the Energy Laws: Summoning comes at a cost. Avoid overflow backlash—or weaponize it as a turning point in battle.
- Fuse Across Factions: Four ancient factions, endless combinations. Cross-breed creatures to create hybrids with dual-race abilities that can turn the tide.
- Face Off in Asynchronous Duels: Venture through single-player boss fights or battle other summoners in high-stakes, turn-based duels.

This game is a love letter to players who crave deep mechanics, unpredictable outcomes, and the thrill of adapting on the fly. We’ve blended elements from roguelikes, deck-builders, and auto-battlers to create a combat system that rewards experimentation and foresight.

WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570110/Summoners_Gambit/
